concept: 濃い青の背景に白斜線の装飾帯を上辺に配置。上段は白文字の大見出し『平均月収 60 万円越え!』で『60』だけを黄色・特大にして数字を強調。左に白枠の実車写真(軽バン)、右に白い帯4本を縦積みし、各帯の左にオレンジのチェックボックスと黒文字の訴求(未経験の方歓迎/車両貸与制度あり/様々な案件多数/加盟金等一切なし)。
prompt: Japanese recruitment banner, 960x640, royal blue background with white diagonal hatch bars along the top corners. Top: huge white bold headline '平均月収 60 万円越え!' where '60' is giant yellow (#ffc928) with dark outline. Left half: a white-bordered photo of a silver kei van parked on asphalt. Right half: four stacked white rounded bands, each with an orange checkbox icon and bold black Japanese text. Flat, high-contrast, impact style.
